principles: No FTS/derived-index (cut-FTS decision); structured overlap only
story-recall module zero outward coupling except types (+ store read port in handler)
drivers: The plan cut FTS for v1; no engine exists

options.name: structured-overlap-over-story_list-scan
pros: No FTS engine / no derived index (the plan's cut-FTS decision)
Reuses the proven story_list scan; explainable structured match reasons

options.name: build-derived-index-or-fts
cons: No FTS engine exists; building one is the plan's explicit anti-goal for v1; adds a persisted index to maintain/invalidate

rationale: The plan explicitly cut FTS; structured overlap over the existing story_list scan is read-only, dependency-free, explainable, and adequate at current story counts. A derived index/embedding is a future optimization, not v1.

preMortem.scenario: Recall builds an FTS engine or derived index
preMortem.trigger: Reaching for a search index for ranking
preMortem.consequence: Violates the cut-FTS decision; new state to invalidate
preMortem.mitigation: Use structured-field overlap over the story_list scan only; smoke asserts no derived-index file is created

preMortem.scenario: Recall writes state or touches a gate
preMortem.trigger: Caching results / logging into gate paths
preMortem.mitigation: handler is read-only; smoke asserts no files written + no gate invoked
core/story-recall.ts imports only experience-layer-types + node:; the store read port lives in the handler; smoke static-scans imports

preMortem.trigger: Scoring by a single overlapping keyword
preMortem.mitigation: Combine multiple structured fields (keywords+fileKinds+touchpoints+type/phase); smoke asserts an overlapping profile outranks a disjoint one and ranking is deterministic
